page.layout: One page of running text. Left margin: year notes (An.M. and 3122 to 3350). Right margin: line numbers 5, 10, 15, 19, 25, 30, 35. Heading in larger type above the passage "Sextum interuallum". Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: An.M.gnauit 2o annis, quia tamen sex menfibus bene vixit, dicitur in Scriptura regnasse tantum 6 men-sibus. Sed prior sententia est magis probabilis.
3122.Ezechias regnat in Iudâ 2. Reg. 16. 18. 19. 20. Hoc tempore prophetasse putantur Habacuc & Nahum.5
3235.Senacherib, cæsis 185000 suis militibus, relinquit obsidionem Hierosolymorum. 2. Reg. 19. Esa.38.
3308.Iosias succedit. 2. Reg. 21. 22. 23. Sub hoc putatur prophetasse Sophoniam. Anno 13 Iosiæ incipit Iere-mias. Ier. 1. v. 2.15
3350.Iechonias succedit. 2. Reg. 24. Hic mense 3 abdu-citur Babylonem.
main_text.head: Sextum interuallum, à captiuitate Babylonicâ vsque ad initium septima-narum Danielis.10
main_text.p: 3350.Captiuitas Babylonica incipit. Quidam illam inchoant ab anno vltimo Zedekiæ, qui fuit annus vndecimus eius regni, & decimus nonus Nebucadnezaris, eamq; finiri aiunt anno secundo Darij Hystaspis. Hanc sententiam probant ex Ier. 25. vbi legimus, terram futuram in solitudinem, & in stuporem 7o annis. Sed non cœpit esse desertâ, nisi ab anno vltimo Zedekiæ, quo tempore Chaldæi templum & vrbem Hierosolymorum incenderunt, & reliquias Iudæorum transtulerunt. Et 2. Paral. vlt. legimus, terram Israëlis sabbatum egisse 7o. annis, id est, quieuisse, iam videl. in desertum & solitudinem redactam. At35 hoc non contigit nisi vltimo anno Zedekiæ. Sed

page.notes: Right margin numbers 5, 10, 15, 19, 25, 30 and 35 are line numbers printed in the margin; their exact lines are approximate, and no 20 is clearly visible. "At" followed by a small mark near the margin may be a reference or a line number; it is copied as "At" with the note 35, which is doubtful. "Iudâ" and "Babylonicâ" with circumflex, and "7o" and "2o" written with a letter o, are copied as the scan shows them and may be misread. Some dates such as 185000 are uncertain at the scan resolution. The top-left "An.M." is the column head of the year notes.
